title: Drafting check for agreements
source: OpenPaperwork: the structure of an agreement, never its merits.

rules.text: Every party is named with its registration number and address.
The agreement states the date it takes effect.
Each defined term is defined once and used.
Every cross-reference points at a clause that exists.
A governing law clause names the law the parties chose, with no placeholder; the library never fills it in.
There is a signature block for every party.
A review names findings item by item and never gives a verdict on the agreement as a whole: not compliant, lawful, valid or approved, and not safe or ready to sign.
rules.source: OpenPaperwork: the library gives no legal advice
